item.title: OLT receives first small scale LNG cargo
item.description: OLT Offshore LNG Toscana received its first small scale LNG cargo at the FSRU Toscana terminal, marking the operational launch of commercial activities for this new service.

item.title: Texas LNG and Kiewit sign EPC contract
item.description: Glenfarne’s Texas LNG Brownsville LLC and Kiewit Energy Group Inc. have announced the execution of an EPC agreement under a lump-sum turnkey contract structure.

item.title: MOL and V.Group sign strategic partnership
item.description: V.Group has announced a strategic partnership with Mitsui O.S.K. Lines, Ltd (MOL) under which V.Ships will assume full technical management of two of MOL’s state-of-the-art newbuild LNG carriers.

item.title: Wood Mackenzie: The Strait of Hormuz closure pressures LNG spot prices, threatens Northeast Asia demand
item.description: Northeast Asia’s LNG market faces a major supply shock following the closure of the Strait of Hormuz, with regional demand expected to fall by 4 – 5 million t through 3Q26 if supply disruptions last for two months, according to new analysis from Wood Mackenzie.

item.title: Cabinet approves renewal of Thailand-Japan LNG and energy security co-operation
item.description: Thailand’s government has approved the renewal of the bilateral co-operation with Japan on LNG to strengthen long-term energy security for both countries.

item.title: Global LNG industry meets in Barcelona at LNGCON 2026 for strategy, dialogue, and collaboration
item.description: The 12th International LNG Congress was hosted by BGS Group in partnership with Enagás and with support from Repsol, Moeve, Baleària, Reganosa, Molgas Energy Group.

item.title: Argent LNG submits application to U.S. Department of Energy for authorisation to export LNG
item.description: Argent LNG, LLC has submitted an application to the U.S. Department of Energy seeking long-term, multi-contract authorisation to export domestically-produced LNG to both free trade agreement (FTA) and non-FTA countries.

item.title: South Asia exposed to US$107 billion LNG bet as Middle East war rages
item.description: As energy markets reel from price spikes following US and Israeli attacks on Iran and renewed shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz, South Asia’s planned expansion of LNG infrastructure could expose the region to long-term economic and energy security risks, according to a new report from Global Energy Monitor.

item.title: New module arrives at Woodfibre LNG
item.description: The liquefaction module arrived at Woodfibre LNG aboard the specialised heavy cargo vessel, Red Zed 1.

item.title: EIG’s MidOcean Energy to acquire additional Gorgon LNG interest from JERA
item.description: MidOcean Energy has entered into definitive agreements with JERA Co., Inc. to acquire JERA Gorgon Pty Ltd, which holds JERA’s 0.417% interest in the Gorgon LNG project.
